name: Higashikyoto Chris
original_name: ひがしきょうとくりす
source:
A private detective. She opened a detective agency with funding from her grandfather.

She's a detective novel enthusiast, and her favorite author is Ellery Queen.

Regarding the investigation of a case, no matter how inexplicable it may seem, she deals with it skeptically and logically.

[Translated from the [url=https://hyperiyon.com/chris/chara.php]official website[/url]]
